regime_context: Hong Kong theme leadership is narrow and defensive: only 4 of 17 themes are trend-gate eligible, led by Energy (H-shares) with the only durable, high-breadth trend. The absolute-trend gate is the single validated risk-control leg for this market (gate_helps true), so any directional comfort should be anchored to eligibility, not rank.
emerging_watch: Watching Banks (H + HK): still eligible but Hurst tag is mean-revert (not trend) and durability is only 0.56 — the weakest eligible trend signal. If Banks loses eligibility or its breadth falls below 0.4, the defensive leadership handoff thesis strengthens toward High-Dividend Blue Chips and away from financials.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Among eligible themes, High-Dividend Blue Chips offers the most balanced risk-control profile: eligible under the absolute-trend gate, trend-prone Hurst tag, healthy breadth (0.625), near-neutral crowding, and durability bar of 0.70. It is not a momentum call (rank-IC ~0), but a staying-power orientation consistent with the one validated edge — drawdown avoidance. The dominant macro backdrop (100% unscheduled surprise share) reinforces a bias toward defensive income over growth themes.
theses.dissent: High-Dividend Blue Chips overlaps heavily with Telecom & Utilities (ineligible, durability 0.44) and Banks (mean-revert, only 0.56 durability). If broad defensiveness rolls over, this basket offers little idiosyncratic protection and could simply track the Hang Seng down.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the clearest trend-gate leader: eligible, durability 0.76 (highest on the board), Hurst trend, breadth 0.80, and not crowded. It is the most coherent expression of the only non-fading, risk-controlled direction the detector highlights. Size should be capped per crowding rules, but direction is not to be fought while the trend-gate remains satisfied.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is narrow and already extended in score (1.545, more than 0.29 above the challenger). For an H-share energy basket there is no ETF proxy in this state, making the direction ungradable, and a risk-on macro reversal into China Tech/Internet would likely strand Energy longs.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is ineligible (score -1.028), mean-reverting, with low durability (0.21) and narrow breadth (0.158). For a trend-gate-disciplined orientation, this is a stay-away, not a short. It is scorable (ETF proxy 3033.HK), so the avoidance is checkable.
theses.dissent: China Tech & Internet is deeply uncrowded (crowding_z -0.89) and unloved; a sharp policy pivot or AI-driven re-rating could produce a violent mean-reversion bounce that a pure trend-gate lens would miss entirely.
